authority.note: Step B evidence only. Structural/outcome labels are provisional hints; M6 judgment decides priority and deck changes.

card_count.note: Spellbook piece count; external payoff cards are reported separately.

dead_card_burden.note: Low-signal means no non-combo role/package, identity-core, tutor-target or recursion signal in the accepted graph/blueprint. It is not a claim that the card is literally dead.

immediate_win.note: `infinite` is never treated as synonymous with immediate win. A judgment/rules review must resolve the endpoint.

independent_usefulness.note: Signals are structural evidence only; they do not substitute for card-by-card judgment.

interaction_windows.note: This is deliberately not an interaction-resilience score; exact stack windows require line-specific rules analysis.

mana.note: Mana value sum is only a curve/setup proxy; alternate costs, rituals, activated costs and colors can make actual startup mana differ.

recovery.note: Blueprint recursion coverage does not prove the whole combo can recover after disruption.

redundancy.note: Near variants share all but roughly one piece; occurrence counts are within this deck's cached Spellbook variants.

resilience.note: Variant redundancy is only one resilience dimension; protection, graveyard hate and recovery are separate.

setup.note: This records declared requirements/enablers; it does not infer hidden sequencing costs.

timing.note: Card types expose broad timing constraints only; exact combo timing remains unresolved.

tutor_accessibility.note: Blueprint tutor targets are deck-specific strategic judgments, not an exhaustive tutor solver.

zones.note: The cached Spellbook record lists pieces/requirements but not a normalized execution-zone requirement for every line.
